name: Can a clogged drain cause a sewer smell?

mainEntity.name: Can a clogged drain cause a sewer smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a clogged drain can definitely contribute to or directly cause sewer odors. A blockage can trap organic matter, which decomposes and releases foul-smelling gases. Furthermore, a severe clog can disrupt the proper flow of water and air in the drain system, potentially affecting the P-trap seal or causing a backup of sewer gases into your living space. Addressing clogs promptly can help eliminate these smells.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, clogs can trap decomposing matter, releasing foul odors, and disrupt drain system flow, allowing sewer gases to escape.
